input_output: DocumentInfo: DocumentRef id/epoch, revision, content_state, dirty/durable flags and project/save identity; RecordSnapshot: DocumentView records plus DocumentInfo.
RecordApplicationOptions injects immutable registry, IRecordStore/IWorkspaceStore ports, limits, validation and owned-row callbacks. Caller is supplied by a trusted host.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: create/open/recover are host lifecycle admissions with Caller and host idempotency key, not writes against an already active WriteContext. Normal open allocates a new DocumentId/Epoch; recovery retains DocumentId and rotates Epoch. Close admits WriteContext and ClosePolicy; clients own projection/tool disposal. Explicit operation versions belong to registry/host dispatch.

additional_owners.role: Read-only typed catalog; host merges legacy and typed capability descriptors.
